hero-20261017-forest.png.prompt:
Use case: compositing / ads-marketing. Refresh an existing Ledger X iOS product marketing banner to the latest real screenshots. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and its layout is the invariant. Input images 2, 3 and 4 are real current app screenshots: use them as the exact screen contents of the three phone mockups. Input image 5 is the actual current app icon: replace any old icon with this cream leaf-L on forest green, without redesigning the icon. Preserve image 1's three-phone composition, typographic hierarchy, subtle phone shadows, margin proportions, and premium restrained style. Landscape 16:9, 2000x1125 or higher with the same ratio. Keep the app screenshots as faithful and legible as possible, do not invent charts, controls, amounts or app features. Screens are screenshots, not new UI designs. Do not add a Dynamic Island, notch or home indicator if it is absent in the supplied screenshots. Every phone must show its entire screenshot framed neatly; no strange duplicated edges. Chinese text must be accurate and typeset cleanly. Marketing copy outside the screens must be exactly the following, with no extra text. Footer is visible and legible. The output is a finished banner, no white frame or watermark.
Preserve the forest-green, warm cream and sage palette of the original hero. The middle phone is the overview screenshot, the left phone is Add, the right phone is Accounts. Keep the original headline concept. Text: brand "Ledger X · iOS"; headline line 1 "口袋里的" line 2 "Beancount"; description line 1 "原生 SwiftUI 记账 App，账本由你保管。" line 2 "纯文本、可追溯，Fava 照常用。"; three bullets: "随手记一笔：分类点选，计算器键盘"; "收支、持仓与往来，随时随地查账"; "离线体验演示账本，支持 App 内更新". Small pill above left phone "分类点选 · 计算器键盘"; above right phone "账户与持仓". Footer "最新主分支实拍 · 2026.10.17 · 数据均为虚构".
